{{Quote|Ah, a challenger! At last I can once again quench my hunger for battle. Come and prove yourself.|Quillara Adeen|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Quillara Adeen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who existed during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she guarded an old [[Jedi statue (Yavin 4)|Jedi statue]] on the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. During her time on Yavin 4, she encountered and battled a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] dispatched by [[Matarmeno Krahnn]], a Human Jedi adventurer hailing from the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Despite being a skilled practitioner of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and making talented use of her single-bladed [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Adeen was bested by her Jedi adversary, and transformed into a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] shortly after her apparent [[Death/Legends|death]].

==Biography==
===The Jedi Adventurer===
{{Quote|You must venture forth and complete this undertaking to fulfill your destiny and achieve the rewards that it offers.|Matarmeno Krahnn instructing a Jedi to defeat Quillara Adeen|<ref name="AED" />}}
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="AED" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] adventurer by the name of [[Matarmeno Krahnn]] hid within the riverside [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="AED" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
During his time in Tyrena, Khrahnn encountered yet another [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]],<ref name="AED" /> a rare sight during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as most Jedi had been wiped out by the end of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="Darth Vader: Extinction">{{Tales|issue1=1|issue2=2|Extinction}}</ref> As a sort of trial, Matarmeno Krahnn urged the Jedi to look within, and embark on a dangerous undertaking to discover various Jedi artifacts throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and defeat two [[The Force/Legends|Force]] users; the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] Jedi [[Bre'ano Umakk]], and the Human female [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] Quillara Adeen.<ref name="AED" />

===Defeating Quillara Adeen===
{{Quote|I would not have believed had I not been here to witness it, but you have proven yourself. Feed your passion.|Quillara Adeen's final words|<ref name="AED" />}}
Quillara Adeen, a practitioner of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], was no stranger to battle. During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Adeen dwelled on the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where she guarded an old [[Jedi statue (Yavin 4)|Jedi statue]] near the [[Wayward Jungle]] region. As the Jedi dispatched by Khrahnn approached the old Jedi statue, the physical manifestation of Adeen appeared in a burst of red, fiery smoke, relishing the opportunity to defeat the individual in battle. However, despite her knowledge of the Force, which included an ability to use [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], and her skill with a single-bladed [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Adeen was bested by her Jedi adversary. As she succumbed to what appeared to be a mortal [[Death/Legends|death]], Adeen uttered her final words, expressing her disbelief at being defeated. However, she also commended the Jedi adversary for proving themselves, and encouraged the Jedi to continue feeding their passion. Adeen then transformed into a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]], before disappearing into a flash of light.<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Quillara Adeen had light freckled skin, auburn [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and green colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Her [[Mouth/Legends|lips]] were covered with black colored makeup. As a Dark Jedi, Adeen had a hunger for battle. After her defeat at the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of her Jedi adversary, Adeen was incredulous. Nevertheless, before she faded away, Adeen acknowledged the prowess of her adversary, and urged the individual to cultivate their passion.<ref name="AED" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a practitioner of the dark side of the Force, Quillara Adeen was capable of using Force lightning. She was also a skilled duelist, as evidenced by her effective use of a lightsaber.<ref name="AED" /> The ability to transcend death was an ability thought to be reserved only for those who embraced the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]].<ref name="Comic">[[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith (comic series)|''Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith'' comic adaptation]]</ref> Nevertheless, upon her death, Adeen was able to transform into a glowing blue Force ghost before vanishing into a burst of light.<ref name="AED" />

==Equipment==
[[File:AdeenLightsaber.png|190px|thumb|Quillara Adeen's lightsaber]]
During her time as a Dark Jedi, Quillara Adeen possessed and made use of a one handed lightsaber with a glowing red energy blade. A traditional Jedi weapon, Adeen's lightsaber consisted of a cylindrical [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|handle]] in which sophisticated circuits channeled a beam of light through a series of [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]]. These [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] modulated the blade's size and amplitude. During her time on Yavin 4, Adeen wore the [[Cloak of Hate]], a black and red [[Clothing/Legends|garment]] imbued with the dark side of the Force. Underneath the [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]], Adeen wore a black formal [[shirt]], black and red lined shorts, and black and red [[Marauder Reconnaissance Armor]] [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quillara Adeen was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> She was added to the game as part of [[W:c:swg:Game Update 3|Game Update 3]] on [[April 29]], [[2008]]<ref name="Game Update 3">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66960&resource=publish#gu3|text=Game Update 3}}</ref> in a [[W:c:swg:Jedi robe|Jedi Robe]] [[W:c:swg:Collection|Collection]] titled "[[W:c:swg:Master Jedi Cloaks|Master Jedi Cloaks]]."<ref name="AED" />

[[W:c:swg:Jedi|Jedi]] players who spoke to [[W:c:swg:Matarmeno Krahnn|Matarmeno Krahnn]] in the [[W:c:swg:City|city]] of [[W:c:swg:Tyrena|Tyrena]] on [[W:c:swg:Corellia|Corellia]] could accept the collection and complete it for the opportunity to obtain two types of [[W:c:swg:Cloaks|cloaks]]; the [[W:c:swg:Cloak of Hate|Cloak of Hate]], and the [[Shatterpoint Cloak]]. To complete the collection, players had to acquire multiple [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] and [[W:c:swg:Lightsaber|lightsaber]] [[W:c:swg:Schematic|schematics]], and demonstrate their [[W:c:swg:Combat|combat]] prowess against the NPCs Bre'ano Umakk and Quillara Adeen, the latter of which spawned on [[W:c:swg:Yavin IV|Yavin 4]].<ref name="AED" />

There is perhaps some ambiguity regarding Quillara Adeen's portrayal in [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']]. Whether she was a mortal being, or some sort of spiritual entity was not explicitly described in any of the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue. When players interacted with the old Jedi statue on Yavin 4 to summon Adeen, she would suddenly appear in a burst of red smoke, and fight the player as a physical entity. Then, once defeated, she would briefly transform into a blue [[W:c:swg:Force|Force]] ghost, before disappearing altogether. Judging from this brief interaction, this article surmises that Adeen was a living physical being until her death at the hands of the player. Although the player could choose not to complete the collection, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="AED" />

The fact that Quillara Adeen, a Dark Jedi, was able to transform into a Force ghost,<ref name="AED" /> might appear to pose something of a [[Canon|continuity]] problem in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity. In both the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novel]] and the [[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith (comic series)|comic book version]] of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], the spirit of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] tells [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] that only light-siders may live on as Force ghosts, and that this is something that dark-siders cannot learn.<ref name="Novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' (novelization)]]</ref><ref name="Comic" /> However, in fact, in ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] reveals that the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] once had the ability to "survive death," but this knowledge was somehow lost over time.<ref name="DarkLord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> Moreover, Exar Kun demonstrated this power.<ref name="Dark Apprentice novel">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>
